{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Clean revenue — remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Step 2: Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Step 3: Confirm the count and total revenue
num_completed = len(filtered_df)
total_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print both values to ensure consistency
print("Number of completed orders (after excluding test orders):")
print(num_completed)

print("Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders):")
print(total_revenue)"}
